projects.description: Project Overview:ChronoCraft is a fully functional, responsive e-commerce web application dedicated to luxury and minimalist timepieces. The platform delivers a seamless, high-end shopping experience, featuring a dynamic product catalog, secure user authentication, and a streamlined checkout pipeline.Key Features Implemented:Dynamic Catalog & Filtering: Built an advanced filtering system using JavaScript and Django ORM, allowing users to instantly sort watches by brand, price, movement type, and strap material.Custom Shopping Cart: Developed a persistent shopping cart using JavaScript session storage and back-end cookies, enabling users to add, modify, or remove items without page reloads.Robust User Accounts: Implemented a secure authentication system using Django's built-in framework, featuring user registration, profile management, and order history tracking.Admin Dashboard: Customized the Django admin panel into a comprehensive vendor dashboard to easily manage inventory, track stock levels, and update order statuses.Fully Responsive UI: Designed a sleek, "dark-luxury" aesthetic using custom CSS and Bootstrap, ensuring a pixel-perfect experience across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
